notes.title: Tuto & UX update - It's time to give Messticulous a second chance!
notes.notes:
Hello ! 

This week I made some updates to improve the game because I know some of you had difficulties to understand some aspects of the game.

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
[list]
[*] tutorial texts are more understandable
[*] actions to accomplish are highlighted to help you know what to do
[*] a new popup explain how to bring back an object placed on a furniture to its initial position
[*] object status is better explained
[*] object trajectory lines color reworked 
[*] changed the luggage's trickshot in room 7 to make it more impressive and satisfying
[/list]

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] next room button accessible after going back to see your job in room 7 was pointing to the wrong room, it's fixed 
[/list]

So, if you've tried the game before and didn't quite get it, now's the time to give it a second chance and overcome the challenge of tidying with trickshots!

Have a great day!

notes.title: Tutorial Update!
notes.notes:
Hello ! 

Here is a small update. Some players were having trouble understanding how to bring back a selected object tossed and placed on something because it requires to delete the force applied to do that.
Now, with this update, a popup will appear for some seconds above an object in this situation to explain this principle!

Should help you to not be stucked and enjoy the game :)

Have fun!

Ludovic
